name: Cleveland State Community College
tuition_note: In-state (TN resident) full-time tuition & fees 2025-26: $2,614/semester for 12 credit hours (incl. fees) per official tnreconnect.gov transfer profile, x2 semesters = ~$5,228/year. No on-campus housing: NCES College Navigator (IPEDS) lists campus housing = No, and CollegeTuitionCompare shows only off-campus room & board. Housing therefore null.
